name: Edict: Silence
description: You speak the draconic word for silence and all sound ceases within a very short (5 unit) radius centered on you for the next minute. All creatures in the area are muted and deafened. Spells channeled within the area are rolled with a penalty die. Sound cannot enter or leave the area. Songs and ballads being performed within the area immediately end. You are immune to these effects.
charge: The radius increases to short (10 units). Creatures within the area that are concentrating on a spell or performing a song must make a concentration check against your spell check or lose their concentration.
